verdict.rationale: The official README shows first-party commands that pull GGUF models directly from Hugging Face by repo ID and run them: `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...`. This clearly delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: detailed docs on download/caching behavior and which model formats or repos are supported (the examples are GGUF-only), and independent or community hands-on corroboration of the -hf download flow.
